sentences.en: Here is some information about history and nature walks in the region. They can be completed in less than a day and also be combined with a visit to Melby, a former coal mine now open to the public.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些关于该地区历史与自然徒步路线的信息。这些路线均可在一天之内完成，也可与参观梅尔比（Melby）——一座现已向公众开放的前煤矿——相结合。

sentences.en: The Marsden Coastal Walk is suitable for all the family as there are no strenuous climbs.
sentences.zh: 马斯登滨海步道适合全家老少，沿途没有陡峭的攀爬路段。

sentences.en: The route begins at Marsden harbour, where there are hourly ferries to and from the beautiful Hooker Island, a great place for fishing. The walk covers part of the coastal path trail. As there are clear signposts all along the way, you don't even need to take a map with YQJJ• At one point, the route goes inland slightly and passes a castle built in the 1400s near to a now-vanished market town. The castle's now just a pile of stones but it's a great place to take photos, and fascinating information boards show what it once looked like. If you set off early, you can be back in time for midday.
sentences.zh: 这条路线始于马斯登港，那里每小时都有渡轮往返风景优美的胡克岛（Hooker Island），该岛是垂钓的理想场所。此步道覆盖了部分滨海小径。由于沿途设有清晰的指示牌，您甚至无需携带地图。途中有一段路线会略微向内陆延伸，经过一座建于15世纪的城堡，该城堡毗邻一座现已消失的市镇。如今城堡仅余一堆石块，但却是绝佳的拍照地点；而富有启发性的信息展板则展示了它昔日的样貌。若您早些出发，便能赶在中午前返回。

sentences.en: The Melby Heritage Walk is a great place to take photos, especially of the night sky. At certain times of the year, people come here from far and wide. They climb to the top of the valley and take pictures of the stars. In the daytime, it's completely different. As you hike through the dense woods in the valley bottom, the only things you'll hear are the sound of your own footsteps. At the highest point, you can stop to take in the views, and those with lots of energy can climb the tower that's situated where there was once a seventeenth century hunting lodge. The route continues along the tops of the hills and brings you back down to the starting point - the car park at Melby Coal Mine.
sentences.zh: 梅尔比遗产步道是拍摄照片的绝佳地点，尤其是夜空照片。每年特定时节，人们从四面八方赶来，登上山谷顶端，拍摄璀璨星空。白天时景象则截然不同：当您穿行于山谷底部茂密的林间小径时，耳边唯有自己脚步的回响。抵达最高点后，您可驻足欣赏全景；体力充沛者还可登上一座塔楼——此处原为一座17世纪的狩猎小屋。随后路线沿山脊顶部延伸，最终带您回到起点——梅尔比煤矿停车场。

sentences.en: Melby Coal Mine has been open to the public for twenty years and has won awards for its visitor experience. Many of the buildings around the mine are still standing and have been converted into display areas.
sentences.zh: 梅尔比煤矿已向公众开放二十年，并因其卓越的游客体验屡获殊荣。矿区周边许多建筑至今仍屹立不倒，并已被改造为展览区域。

sentences.en: 011/12 011/12 013/14 013/14 Firstly, there's an exhibition showing the history of the mine, with many original black and white photos. To see that, you go from the car park, via a covered walkway to the Main Visitor Centre. Go through the ticket office to an area where there are lockers to leave heavy bags in. and where you can borrow raincoats. Beyond that room is the exhibition.
sentences.zh: 首先，这里设有一场展示煤矿历史的展览，展出大量原始黑白照片。参观该展览需从停车场出发，经由一条有顶棚的通道前往主游客中心；穿过售票处后，即到达一个设有储物柜（供寄存大件行李）及可供借用雨衣的区域；再往前便是展览厅。

sentences.en: There's a small bathhouse where miners used to wash after their shift underground. You can see that in the building directly to the north of the engine house. The boiler has gone from there now, but there are lines of tin baths on the stone floor.
sentences.zh: 这里有一座小型浴室，矿工们过去在地下作业结束后便在此清洗身体。该浴室位于动力机房正北方向的建筑内。如今锅炉已拆除，但石质地面上仍整齐排列着一排锡制浴盆。

sentences.en: There's a display of early mining tools from the days before mechanisation. You can find that in a small L-shaped building in the middle of the northern boundary of the site. It's incredible to think how miners were able to use hand implements to cut through rock.
sentences.zh: 这里陈列着机械化采矿时代之前使用的早期采矿工具。该展品位于场地北边界中央的一座小型L形建筑内。令人难以置信的是，矿工们当年仅凭手工工具便能凿穿坚硬岩层。

sentences.en: The vehicle shed, where you can find wagons of different sizes, along with some of the hi-tech cutting machines that were in use until the mine closed, is in the southwest corner of the site. and can be accessed via a covered walkway.
sentences.zh: 车辆棚位于场地西南角，内有各种尺寸的矿车以及一些直至煤矿关闭前仍在使用的高科技切割设备。该棚可通过一条有顶棚的通道进入。

sentences.en: There is a field with ponies. which are always popular with children. on the north-eastern boundary of the site, not approached via a covered walkway.
sentences.zh: 在场地东北边界处有一片牧场，里面饲养着小矮马，深受儿童喜爱；该区域不设顶棚通道通往。

sentences.en: The other building to mention is the education centre. This is where school groups go when they visit the mine, but it's also accessible to the public as it contains a library and small gift shop. The centre is connected to the ticket office via a short section of covered walkway.
sentences.zh: 另一处值得一提的建筑是教育中心。学校团体来访时通常在此开展活动，但公众亦可进入参观，因中心内设有一座图书馆及一家小型礼品店。该中心通过一段短距离的有顶棚通道与售票处相连。
